tool_arguments.prompt: Draw one fresh complete friendly spotted hotoke loach character on transparent RGBA, using attached canonical neutral only as identity/style reference. One drawing, not a sheet. Same left-facing view, broad rounded body, original brown spots, short barbels, fins and fan tail, warm brown outline and contained watercolor texture. Pose: a small welcoming wave by lifting ONLY the existing near pectoral fin; every other existing fin rests as in neutral. Absolutely NO motion/speed marks, strokes or symbols outside or beside the fin, no extra fins or human hand, no water/background/floor. Keep the reference body size/proportion, head angle and body center; complete appendages and generous clear transparent padding.

original_output.availability: Historical tool location; bundled saved_output is the usable original.

record_scope: Selected source only. Historical candidate/QA files are source-workspace history, not bundled dependencies.
